hypotheses.R0_manual_native_matches_checkpoint: Every scale's native branch matches checkpoint logits to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.R1_small_ablation_recovers_probe_roles: At 10 percent removal, at least four frozen heads reach signed causal AUROC at least 0.60.
hypotheses.R2_selected_heads_beat_controls_locally: At 10 percent removal, at least four frozen heads exceed their same-layer control-head median by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.R3_causal_role_is_scale_stable: At least four candidates retain the same calibration sign at every scale and evaluation AUROC at least 0.55 at three or more scales.
hypotheses.R4_full_ablation_null_was_low_power: With the larger splits, at least four candidates reach AUROC 0.60 under full removal.
hypotheses.R5_broad_head_semantic_ontology_remains_: Fewer than four candidates satisfy AUROC 0.60 at any single tested scale.
